method: Each criterion's own way of checking carried out on the current files: commands and greps on the working tree; behaviour probes and writes only on a copy of Sai in <scratch> (team homes, Pixel Office stands and servers on port 0, one headless Chrome at a time); criteria about how a run went — by the run's handoffs and files. One full `npm run check` on the working tree and one on a clean copy.
check_command: cd tools && node -v -> v22.21.1; cd tools && npm run check (working tree, own turn, foreground) -> exit 0, '# tests 2065 # pass 2065 # fail 0 # cancelled 0 # skipped 0 # todo 0'; clean copy of the whole Sai folder without node_modules in <scratch>/copy: npm ci -> exit 0 (80 packages, 0 vulnerabilities), npm run check -> exit 0, the same 2065/2065, skipped 0, todo 0 (format:check, lint --max-warnings 0, traces, handoffs-check, test all ran)
